title: Human fecal 16S rRNA sequencing raw data
author: Liao Peng
license_note: figshare article detail endpoint license.name: CC BY 4.0

steps.title: Collect fecal samples
steps.instruction: Obtain fecal specimens from 32 Hunner‑type IC/BPS patients and 30 healthy control individuals.

steps.title: Amplify V3‑V4 region
steps.instruction: Amplify the V3–V4 hypervariable regions of the bacterial 16S rRNA gene using primers 338F and 806R on a GeneAmp 9700 PCR system.

steps.title: Sequence amplicons on MiSeq
steps.instruction: Perform paired‑end 300‑bp sequencing of the PCR products on an Illumina MiSeq PE300 platform (Illumina, San Diego, USA) following the standard protocols of Majorbio Bio‑Pharm Technology Co. Ltd. (Shanghai, China).

steps.title: Calculate alpha diversity
steps.instruction: Compute alpha‑diversity indices (Chao, ACE, Shannon, Simpson) and the coverage index to assess within‑sample diversity and sequencing depth.

steps.title: Perform beta diversity analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze inter‑individual variation by principal coordinates analysis (PCoA) and evaluate significance with the Adonis test.

steps.title: Identify differential taxa
steps.instruction: Identify taxa that differ in abundance between groups using Linear Discriminant Analysis Effect Size (LEfSe).
